# Publish gate report

**Going out:** Search ad (headline + description) for Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** All three claims are on the policy allowlist, word for word or close to it.
  | Claim | Status |
  |---|---|
  | "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time." | Policy §2 (subscription terms) |
  | "Free UK delivery on orders over £25." | Policy §2 (shipping policy) |
  | "Monthly loose leaf tea." | Product fact, fine as written |

  There are no stats, superlatives, guarantees, testimonials or urgency lines.
- **Regulated claims:** The ad mentions prices and delivery terms. The £25 threshold matches the policy, and there are no "was" prices or countdowns. No health, money, environmental or children's claims.
- **House style:** The copy is warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. I'd score it about 92/100. It is a bit flat, but that suits a search ad.
- **Disclosure:** Paid ads from our own account are labelled by the platform (policy §4), so no extra label is needed. There are no affiliate, gifted or AI-content issues.

**Fixed:** Nothing needed changing.

**Needs a decision:** Nothing is blocking. One thing to check: the ad can't promise more than its landing page, so confirm the page shows the £25 free-delivery threshold and the pause/cancel terms.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). This ad is not approved yet. I haven't recorded an approval, and Sam needs to say yes to this exact text before it goes live.
